correctness.rationale: Every face is explicitly enumerated as a subset of a ten-element metric ball, the complement involution is fixed-face-free, and the full 960-triangle 2-skeleton is certified through six complete S6-orbits. The cross-polytope-sphere two-skeleton proves simple connectivity; the resulting free double cover proves pi1 and integral H1 of the quotient equal Z/2. Exact integer cellular boundary identities and rational Gaussian elimination on the original and signed quotient cellular matrices yield all stated Betti numbers; transfer yields involution traces.

value.rationale: The first self-complementary three-uniform middle layer is a canonical finite metric object with a natural free involution. Its quotient has newly identified integral 2-torsion in H1 and exact degree-three and -four rational invariants, plus a character distinguishing the quotient from the known unquotiented sphere ranks. The symmetric two-skeleton mechanism is structural and potentially relevant to higher self-complementary layers; no family generalization is asserted.
